name: tradebuddy
description: TradeBuddy MVP — opportunity radar, portfolio intelligence, mock broker and development market data behind replaceable provider interfaces

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace=server" "npm run dev --workspace=client"
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=server && npm run lint --workspace=client
scripts.format: npm run format --workspace=server && npm run format --workspace=client
